subject: Investigate #38 failures: is the gold fact IN the retrieved context (answer-quality) or MISSING (retrieval-precision)?
description:
#38 gave our-way 26.7% LoCoMo / 40% LME-S with context_keys=5 on every probe, but 14 of 20 our-way probes failed (mostly "I don't know" despite retrieved context). Determine the dominant failure mode so we fix the right end.

For EACH of the 14 failing our-way probes (read rerun3-output results at C:\\Users\\Imyu\\.zonoid-bench-data\\rerun3-output): fetch the 5 retrieved context notes' SUMMARIES (from the rerun3 embedded-daemon workspace .graph/nodes/note%3A<id>.jsonl — the "summary" field; if those workspaces were cleaned, reconstruct the session text from the dataset session the note came from). Concatenate the 5 summaries = the injected context the answerer saw. Then judge: is the gold answer's fact actually PRESENT in that context (allow for different phrasing — read and decide, don't require exact string match)?
- PRESENT but answered wrong/"I don't know" → ANSWER-QUALITY (retrieved the needle, failed to extract it).
- ABSENT → RETRIEVAL-PRECISION (the top-5 didn't include the needle).

Report: the count split (X answer-quality vs Y retrieval-precision) for LoCoMo and LME-S separately, 2-3 concrete examples of each (question, gold, what the context contained, the prediction), and the dominant mode per dataset.

This is READ-ONLY post-hoc analysis — gold is used ONLY to classify already-produced results, never to re-run any arm. No embedded daemon, no LLM answering, no bench run — just read the results + the note summaries + classify. Bounded foreground work, NO run_in_background, NO poll loop. Flat task off main.
